Q20.rule: removing interventional training worsens the verdict EE significantly (paired suite difference EE_ablated - EE_full, unstratified system bootstrap, one-sided p <= 0.05)

direct_variant.report: outcomes not predictable even without the bottleneck (attributed to excitation / data; goal5 section 94 B)

levelb_fullstate_baseline.report: outcomes not predictable even without the bottleneck (attributed to excitation / data; goal5 section 94 B)

Q21.report: outcomes not predictable even without the bottleneck (attributed to excitation / data; goal5 section 94 B)

thresholds.near: one-sided 95 % upper bound of mean(EE_M - EE_direct) < delta_C_suite = 0.05
thresholds.predicts: one-sided 95 % upper bound of the suite mean EE < 1 - delta_A = 0.9

descriptive_note: per-switch tests are descriptive (Holm across switches per metric reported); Q20 / Q21 are the pre-registered critical tests
not_a_result: DRY RUN on the Level B selection tier with stand-in models, before the lock: not a result; never released, never used for any decision

history_delay: the stand-in's compact encoder reads the current sample only
shared_dynamics: the stand-in fits every system independently
uncertainty_ensemble: the stand-in reports no uncertainty and has no ensemble
